summary.text: Mary Hakken-Phillips is a Democratic member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Grafton 12 who has held the seat since December 2, 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney, she earned a J.D. from Michigan State University in 2017.

paragraphs.text: Mary Hakken-Phillips earned a B.A. in political science from Alma College in 2003, an M.A. in political science from Loyola University Chicago in 2006, and a J.D. from Michigan State University in 2017.
Her career experience includes working as an attorney with the Tarbell & Brodich law firm.
In the 2023-2024 session, Hakken-Phillips was assigned to the House Finance Committee and its Finance - Division II Committee.
